os.environ.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE","core.settings")
import django
django.setup()
from django.db import connection,transaction
from django.db.migrations.executor import MigrationExecutor
from django.apps import apps
from django.conf import settings
from pathlib import Path
from apps.data_center.infrastructure.publication_models import CanonicalPublicationModel,PublicationMemberModel,CoverageSnapshotModel
from django.db.models import Count,Min,Max,Q
keys=["equity.quote.snapshot","equity.price.bar","equity.valuation.fact","equity.financial.fact"]
with transaction.atomic():
 with connection.cursor() as c:
  c.execute("SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY")
  c.execute("SELECT current_setting('transaction_read_only'),current_setting('transaction_isolation'),transaction_timestamp()")
  tx=c.fetchone()
 executor=MigrationExecutor(connection)
 migrations=sorted((a,n) for a,n in executor.loader.applied_migrations)
 result={"transaction":tx,"build_identity":json.loads(Path(settings.AGOM_BUILD_IDENTITY_PATH).read_text()),"release_manifest":json.loads(Path(settings.AGOM_RELEASE_MANIFEST_PATH).read_text()),"applied_migration_count":len(migrations),"pending_migrations":[[m.app_label,m.name,backward] for m,backward in executor.migration_plan(executor.loader.graph.leaf_nodes())],"migration_graph_sha256":hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(migrations,separators=(",",":")).encode()).hexdigest(),"datasets":{}}
 for key in keys:
  qs=CanonicalPublicationModel.objects.filter(dataset_key=key)
  current=list(qs.filter(publication_key="current",state="published").values("publication_id","dataset_key","publication_key","publication_hash","state","member_count","coverage_requested_count","coverage_selected_count","coverage_missing_count","as_of","published_at","must_not_use_for_decision","blocked_reason"))
  for p in current:
   members=PublicationMemberModel.objects.filter(publication_id=p["publication_id"])
   p["members"]=members.aggregate(count=Count("pk"),missing_observed_at=Count("pk",filter=Q(observed_at__isnull=True)),oldest=Min("observed_at"),newest=Max("observed_at"))
   p["member_fact_tables"]=list(members.values("fact_table").annotate(count=Count("pk")))
   p["coverage_snapshots"]=list(CoverageSnapshotModel.objects.filter(publication_id=p["publication_id"]).values())
  result["datasets"][key]={"all_publication_count":qs.count(),"current_published":current}
 result["fact_model_schema"]={m.__name__:{"table":m._meta.db_table,"fields":[f.name for f in m._meta.fields]} for m in apps.get_app_config("data_center").get_models() if m.__name__ in ("QuoteSnapshot","PriceBar","ValuationSnapshot","FinancialFact","AssetMaster")}
 print(json.dumps(result,default=str,sort_keys=True))

import os,json,io
os.environ.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE","core.settings")
import django
django.setup()
from django.db import connection,transaction
from django.core.management import call_command
with transaction.atomic():
 with connection.cursor() as c:
  c.execute("SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY")
  c.execute("SELECT current_setting('transaction_read_only'),current_setting('transaction_isolation'),transaction_timestamp()")
  tx=c.fetchone()
 result={"transaction":tx,"commands":{}}
 for name in ("repair_active_a_share_current_facts","rebuild_active_a_share_core_publications"):
  out=io.StringIO()
  try:
   call_command(name,stdout=out,no_color=True)
   result["commands"][name]={"outcome":"returned","stdout":out.getvalue()}
  except Exception as exc:
   result["commands"][name]={"outcome":"error","error_type":type(exc).__name__,"message":str(exc),"stdout":out.getvalue()}
   if connection.needs_rollback:break
 print(json.dumps(result,default=str,sort_keys=True))

import os,json
os.environ.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE","core.settings")
import django
django.setup()
from django.db import connection,transaction
from apps.data_center.infrastructure.models import QuoteSnapshotModel,PriceBarModel,FinancialFactModel
from apps.data_center.infrastructure.publication_models import CanonicalPublicationModel,PublicationMemberModel
from apps.data_center.infrastructure.price_bar_repository import _price_bar_publication_reference
from apps.data_center.infrastructure.financial_fact_repository import _financial_publication_reference
from apps.data_center.infrastructure.quote_snapshot_repository import QuoteSnapshotRepository
from apps.data_center.application.publication_utils import publication_hash
from django.db.models import Q
specs={"equity.quote.snapshot":QuoteSnapshotModel,"equity.price.bar":PriceBarModel,"equity.financial.fact":FinancialFactModel}
with transaction.atomic():
 with connection.cursor() as c:
  c.execute("SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY")
  c.execute("SELECT current_setting('transaction_read_only'),transaction_timestamp()")
  tx=c.fetchone()
 results=[]
 for p in CanonicalPublicationModel.objects.filter(dataset_key__in=specs,publication_key="current",state="published",must_not_use_for_decision=False).filter(Q(superseded_at__isnull=True)|Q(reinstated_at__isnull=False)).order_by("dataset_key"):
  members=list(PublicationMemberModel.objects.filter(publication_id=p.publication_id).order_by("natural_key","source"))
  model=specs[p.dataset_key];rows=model.objects.in_bulk([int(m.fact_pk) for m in members]);refs=[];mismatches=[];missing=[]
  for m in members:
   row=rows.get(int(m.fact_pk))
   if row is None:missing.append(m.fact_pk);continue
   if p.dataset_key=="equity.price.bar":ref=_price_bar_publication_reference(row)
   elif p.dataset_key=="equity.financial.fact":ref=_financial_publication_reference(row)
   else:
    repo=QuoteSnapshotRepository();ref=repo.list_publication_candidates([repo._from_model(row)])[0]
   refs.append(ref)
   changed=[k for k in ("natural_key","source","source_record_id","fact_table","fact_pk","observed_at","raw_payload_hash","quality_status","revision_number") if getattr(ref,k)!=getattr(m,k)]
   if changed:mismatches.append({"member_id":str(m.member_id),"fields":changed})
  digest=publication_hash(sorted(refs,key=lambda x:x.natural_key))
  results.append({"dataset_key":p.dataset_key,"publication_id":str(p.publication_id),"member_count":len(members),"missing_fact_pks":missing,"mismatches":mismatches,"stored_publication_hash":p.publication_hash,"recomputed_from_live_facts":digest,"live_fact_hash_matches":digest==p.publication_hash,"blank_raw_hash_uses_persisted_fact_fallback":True})
 print(json.dumps({"transaction":tx,"results":results},default=str))
